'''Kanaver''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster's]] [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. By around [[25,130 BBY]], it was one of the leading worlds of the [[Livien League]] confederation, which later became a part of the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] conqueror [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, Kanaver emerged from a long period of isolation and economic stagnation to become an active regional [[Spaceport/Legends|port]].

==Description==
Kanaver was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Kanaver system/Legends|Kanaver system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kanaver lay on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which connected it to the [[Desev system]] as well as the [[Janodral Mizar system/Legends|Janodral Mizar system]] of the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]].<ref name="Xim" />

==History==
[[File:Livien_League.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Kanaver was one of the leading worlds of the Livien League.]]
Between approximately [[25,150 BBY]]<ref name="Xim" /> and [[25,096 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Desevran Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked Kanaver to the [[Amarin system/Legends|Amarin system]]; however, that route eventually changed its course and no longer passed through Kanaver. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Kanaver, along with the worlds [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]] and [[Livien]], led the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] people's confederation known as the [[Livien League]]. After his ascension to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of the [[Kingdom of Cron]]<ref name="Xim" /> in 25,130 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> both the Livien League and Kanaver were incorporated into<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Cronese]] [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]].<ref name="Xim" />

Over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], Kanaver entered a [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-long period of economic stagnation and relative isolation; however, it eventually re-established ties with the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Kanaver became a busy [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] serving the worlds located in the Tion Hegemony regions [[Back Spiral|beyond]] the [[Indrexu Spiral]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], along the [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route, and Rimward along the Perlemian.<ref name="Xim" /> At an [[Unidentified Desevro space station|orbital station]] above Desevro, passengers and cargo from most [[Starship/Legends|starships]] arriving from worlds such as [[Barseg]], [[Cadinth]], [[Chandaar]], and [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] were transferred to ships traveling to worlds such as Kanaver, [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]], and [[Tion]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kanaver was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GatORW" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]], [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] placed it in grid square S-5.<ref name="Xim" />
